newsitem.title: UK: Fraud costs UK insurers 700 mln stg a year - report.
newsitem.headline: Fraud costs UK insurers 700 mln stg a year - report.

text.p: The cost of fraud to UK general insurers was 684 million stg in 1995, management consultancy Datamonitor said in its report "Fraud in UK financial services."
Life insurers lost 87 million stg to fraud out of a total bill to the financial services industry of 1.316 billion stg.
General insurance fraud has fallen in the last three years, but more needs to be done "before the sector as a whole can claim to have reached an acceptable level of fraud," the report said.
Motor insurance suffers the biggest fraud losses of any class of general insurance at an estimated 301 million stg in 1995.
Datamonitor's estimates of the cost of insurance fraud are higher than those of the Association of British Insurers (ABI).
Its latest statistics for 1996 show a 4.5 percent fall to an estimated 560 million stg for all types of insurance fraud.
